# Standard Operating Procedure: Production API Deployment ## 1. Overview and Pre-Deployment Gates
All microservices deployed to production Kubernetes clusters must pass automated CI/CD pipeline checks before traffic migration. Prior to initiating a deployment:
- All unit tests must achieve a minimum of 85% branch coverage. - Vulnerability scans must report zero critical or high severity CVEs. - Load testing must confirm P99 latency remains under 200ms at 1,500 RPS. ## 2. Canary Deployment Strategy
Deployments must execute via progressive canary rollout:
1. **Canary Phase 1 (5% traffic):** Traffic routed to canary pods for 15 minutes. Error rates must not exceed 0.05%. 2. **Canary Phase 2 (25% traffic):** Traffic increased to 25% for 30 minutes. Memory utilization must remain below 75%. 3. **Full Promotion (100% traffic):** If all health metrics remain green, the release is promoted to 100% across all production nodes. ## 3. Automated Rollback Triggers
An automated rollback to the previous stable release hash is triggered immediately if:
- HTTP 5xx error rate spikes above 0.5% over a 3-minute rolling window.

b6c0c880-ce63-4a4f-8644-de0bae38b8e3.content:
- The Kubernetes readiness probe fails for more than 3 consecutive retries on more than 20% of pods. - Latency P95 exceeds 500ms for more than 5 continuous minutes. Rollback command:
`kubectl rollout undo deployment/api-gateway -n production`

# Production Error Codes & Incident Severity Matrix ## 1. Incident Severity Definitions and SLAs
- **Severity P1 (Critical Outage):** Core payment processing or user authentication down. SLA Response Time: 15 minutes. Escalation: VP of Engineering and Incident Commander. - **Severity P2 (Major Degradation):** Non-blocking service failure or customer portal partial impairment. SLA Response Time: 1 hour. Escalation: SRE Lead on-call. - **Severity P3 (Minor Glitch):** Cosmetic UI issues or non-critical background batch job delays. SLA Response Time: 4 business hours. ## 2. Standard Production Error Code Reference
The following error codes correspond to internal telemetry events: - `ERR-502-TIMEOUT`: Upstream gateway timed out waiting for backend gRPC response (>30,000ms). Action: Check Redis connection pool saturation on node cluster `SKU-PROD-CLUSTER-A4`. - `ERR-901-DATABASE-FAILOVER`: Primary PostgreSQL node disconnected. Automatic read-replica promotion initiated. Action: Verify split-brain prevention lock in Consul. - `ERR-403-TOKEN-EXPIRED`: JSON Web Token signature verification failed or token passed 24-hour expiration threshold. Client must re-authenticate with refresh token.

41e971fb-adc0-495d-8b1d-37e10ed5237a.content: Client must re-authenticate with refresh token. - `ERR-304-CACHE-STALE`: Local edge cache TTL expired. Automatic cache invalidation sent to Cloudflare edge nodes.

# STRICTLY CONFIDENTIAL: Executive Compensation & Severance Schedules ## 1. Scope and Access Restrictions
This document contains sensitive material regarding executive leadership equity cliffs, severance multiplier formulas, and board-level change-of-control provisions. Access is restricted strictly to C-Suite Officers (CEO, CFO, CTO) and Members of the Board of Directors. ## 2. Annual Performance Incentive Plan (APIP)
Executive cash bonuses are determined according to annual corporate EBITDA milestones:
- Threshold attainment (80% of annual recurring revenue target): 50% target payout. - Target attainment (100% ARR target): 100% target payout. - Maximum outperformance (125%+ ARR target): 200% target payout cap. ## 3. Equity Acceleration and Double-Trigger Provisions
In the event of a change-of-control transaction (Merger, Acquisition, or Sale of Assets):
- 100% of unvested Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) accelerate immediately upon termination without cause within 12 months following transaction close (Double-Trigger Clause). - Severance payout equals 18 months of base salary plus prorated target bonus, along with 18 months of subsidized COBRA healthcare continuation.

# Corporate Travel, Meals and Expense Reimbursement Policy ## 1. Flight and Transportation Standards
All business travel must be booked via Navan (formerly TripActions) at least 14 days in advance to secure favorable enterprise rates. - **Domestic Flights (<6 hours flight duration):** Economy class is mandatory for all personnel. - **International / Long-Haul Flights (>6 continuous hours):** Premium Economy is permitted with Director approval. Business class is reserved exclusively for flights exceeding 10 hours with scheduled client meetings within 12 hours of landing. - **Rideshare and Rental Cars:** Uber/Lyft standard ride types are reimbursable. Rental car reservations are restricted to intermediate/sedan category unless traveling with 3+ colleagues. ## 2. Daily Meals & Incidentals Per Diem (M&IE)
Daily meal allowances operate under a fixed per diem cap:
- **Domestic Travel:** Up to $75 USD per full travel day ($15 Breakfast, $25 Lunch, $35 Dinner). Alcohol is non-reimbursable unless hosting approved client entertainment. - **International Travel:** Up to $120 USD per travel day.

# Global Employee Leave and Remote Working Policy ## 1. Annual Leave Entitlement
Full-time regular employees accrue 24 paid annual leave days per calendar year. - A maximum of 5 unused leave days may be carried over into the following year, expiring by March 31st. - Leave requests exceeding 5 consecutive business days require manager approval at least 14 days in advance via Workday. - Sick leave: Employees receive up to 10 paid sick leave days annually with no medical certificate required for absences under 2 days. ## 2. Remote and Hybrid Work Guidelines
Employees working in hybrid-eligible roles may work remotely up to 3 days per week. - **Core Collaboration Hours:** All employees, regardless of location, must remain accessible on Slack and email between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM Eastern Standard Time (EST). - **Home Office Setup Allowance:** Full-time permanent employees are eligible for a one-time reimbursement of up to $500 USD for ergonomic equipment (monitors, chairs, standing desk converters). Receipts must be submitted within 60 days of hire.
